title: VoiceLoop evaluation report v1
description: report.json produced by evaluate(artifact_uri, eval_sets, config). Includes metrics, paired-bootstrap confidence intervals and slice metrics. e2e_booking_accuracy is the primary promotion metric (context.md section 2 invariant 4 and section 9); WER alone must never drive a promotion decision. The evaluated artifact_uri must be the converted artifact that will actually serve.

schema_version.description: Exact version of this report format; bump and note in docs/CHANGELOG.md on any change.

artifact_uri.description: URI of the deployed-form artifact actually evaluated (CTranslate2, ONNX or merged adapter), not a raw training checkpoint.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the report was produced (RFC 3339).

eval_sets.description: Evaluation sets included in this report. The general-capability set covers silence, line noise and other served languages.

champion_report_uri.description: URI of the champion report used for the comparison, if any.

EvalSet.description: golden = sealed hand-labelled random sample; regression = all past reviewed failures; general_capability = silence, noise and other served languages.

Metrics.description: Aggregate metrics over the evaluated sets. All values are numeric; e2e_booking_accuracy is the primary promotion metric.

wer.description: Word error rate. May exceed 1 when insertions outnumber reference words; never use it alone for promotion.

entity_error.description: Entity-level error for names, dates and numbers.

slot_f1.description: Parser slot F1 against reviewed slots.

schema_valid_rate.description: Fraction of parser outputs valid against the booking JSON Schema.

e2e_booking_accuracy.description: PRIMARY PROMOTION METRIC: booking-field accuracy measured end to end from audio (STT + parser + booking record comparison).

ConfidenceInterval.description: Paired-bootstrap confidence interval. Both bounds and the confidence level must be present; a half-bound interval is invalid.

ConfidenceIntervals.description: Paired-bootstrap intervals keyed by metric name. Intervals for all five core metrics are required; add entries for any extra reported metric.

SliceMetric.description: Per-metric numbers for one slice. Recommended keys mirror the core metrics; additional numeric diagnostics (for example hallucination_rate) are allowed.

SliceMetrics.description: Metrics keyed by slice name. Critical slices from context.md section 9 are names, dates, numbers, silence and other_languages; other slices may be added.

DecodingSettings.description: Exact decoding settings used to produce the evaluated artifact's outputs. Test the settings that will run in production; converted CTranslate2 models can behave differently with hotwords, an initial prompt or condition_on_previous_text (context.md section 10).

ShadowEvidence.description: Silent candidate-vs-champion comparison on live traffic. Required by P3-08 before STT promotion; no result from shadow mode may affect a live call.

GateDecision.description: Optional recorded gate outcome. The pass rule is a margin over champion on e2e_booking_accuracy plus no regression on critical slices, using CI bounds (context.md section 9).
